note: RPCS3 Core 932 = Core 931 plus the ARMSX3 21863 lot and the first fixes of the maintainer audit of 11 Nov 2026 (relayed by Codex; docs/rpcs3-core932-lot-armsx3-audit.md): COREPROF ENERGY931 prints invalid for a counter that went backwards and names a window without frames, CPU time or cycles instead of printing 0 (discontinuities=), and adds the disk reads and writes, logical writes and page-ins of the window; THERMAL931 adds the time spent in each thermal state, mixed windows and the measured WFE wake latency (REWINDBOX_THERMAL_LEDGER_932, REWINDBOX_EVENT_WAIT_LATENCY_932); a launch sent to the background while it starts is paused once running (REWINDBOX_BACKGROUND_PAUSE_931 transition request); from the fair thermal state the texture prehash depth halves when less than two thirds of it was used (floor 4, at most 32 from serious); MoltenVK compiles pipelines concurrently (MVK_CONFIG_SHOULD_MAXIMIZE_CONCURRENT_COMPILATION); the JIT arena fallback shrinks by a quarter step (REWINDBOX_JIT_STEP_932); the ARMSX3 21863 game patches are a separate patch source, 42 of 49 enabled by default (the 5 LittleBigPlanet 2, Batman and Tales of Graces f entries and the Killzone 3 MLAA entries keep their default), the user's choice saved; two database settings follow their game patch when every condition holds (PATCHRELIEF932: Gran Turismo 6 Disable MLAA -> Write and Read Color Buffers off, Grand Theft Auto IV collision fix -> Approximate XFloat); six Black Ops II serials resolve to the BLES01717 rules (REWINDBOX_TITLE_VARIANTS_932). Resolution, frame rate and SPU settings unchanged; no frame limit. Replaces the Core 931 pin directly (Core 929 kept as the fallback in docs/evidence/rpcs3-core929). No codegen input changes: PPU and SPU codegen identities unchanged. MoltenVK dependency of run 42998604606 (libMoltenVK.a d19d3a42). Request 1's Apple host job (run 43068680664) passed 14 of 15 commands and failed in the core932 driver on PyYAML, absent from the runner's Python: the lot test reads the canary file with a YAML subset reader since c54a09ef (compared with PyYAML wherever installed, every check kept), and the Apple host harnesses were rerun alone. Built by the RPCS3 Core route (run 43068680664, attempt 1, source 24f09446; Apple host harnesses run 43073197832 on dba7158e). Verified offline on the downloaded artifacts with the repository verifier (pin_errors and bundle); the packaged library holds the 932 report fields, the two PATCHRELIEF932 lines, the MoltenVK setting and the whole ARMSX3 21863 patch file. Not measured on the iPhone; no energy, temperature or FPS claim.
